items.title: Accuracy of Antibody Testing in Myasthenia Gravis: The ADAM Study.
items.abstract: Antibody testing has a pivotal role in the diagnosis of myasthenia gravis (MG). However, there are limited data on the accuracy of the different methods available for acetylcholine receptor (AChR) and muscle-specific kinase (MuSK) autoantibody (Ab) detection in a real-world setting. Our aim was to compare the diagnostic accuracy of in-house live cell-based assay (L-CBA), a commercially available fixed CBA (F-CBA), and an indirect ELISA in detecting AChR and MuSK antibodies in patients with suspected MG. Between July 2023 and December 2025, we prospectively recruited consecutive adult and pediatric patients with suspected MG across 4 Italian centers. Patients undergoing immunotherapy and those with incomplete diagnostic work-up or insufficient samples were excluded. Serum samples were tested blindly by L-CBA, F-CBA, and ELISA for AChR and MuSK antibodies. MG diagnosis was established independently based on neurologic examination, electrophysiologic studies, and/or sustained clinical response to pyridostigmine or corticosteroids as well as exclusion of other diagnoses. Diagnostic sensitivity, specificity, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were calculated using final diagnosis as the reference standard. Of the 327 included patients (median age 63 years, interquartile range 26, 52.9% female), 152 were diagnosed with MG and 175 with other diagnoses. For AChR antibodies, sensitivity was 71.7% (95% CI 63.8-78.7) for L-CBA, 69% (61.0-76.3) for F-CBA, and 63.8% (55.6-71.4) for ELISA, while specificity was 97.7% (94.2-99.3) for both CBAs vs 69.1% (61.7-75.9) for ELISA. ELISA showed lower concordance with CBAs and produced substantially more false positives (30.9%). For MuSK antibodies, sensitivity was similar (6.6 vs 7.2%) and specificity 100% across assays. ROC curve analysis confirmed higher diagnostic accuracy for L-CBA (AUC 0.85) compared with F-CBA (0.83) ( CBAs, especially live, demonstrated superior diagnostic performance for AChR antibody detection compared with ELISA, particularly in ocular MG. L-CBA showed a modest but significant diagnostic advantage over F-CBA, although fixed assays can be considered as a practical, nearly equivalent alternative, suitable for routine laboratories. By contrast, ELISA demonstrated lower specificity and should be interpreted cautiously. This study shows Class I data that L-CBA and F-CBA compare favorably with ELISA testing of AChR-Ab and MuSK-Ab, in the diagnosis of MG.
items.summary_ja:
背景：重症筋無力症（MG）の診断において抗体検査は重要だが、アセチルコリン受容体（AChR）および筋特異的キナーゼ（MuSK）自己抗体検出法の実際の精度データは限られている。  
方法：2023年7月から2025年12月までに、イタリアの4施設でMG疑い患者327名（成人・小児）を前向きに登録。免疫療法中や検査不十分な患者は除外。血清を用いて、ライブ細胞ベースアッセイ（L-CBA）、固定細胞ベースアッセイ（F-CBA）、間接ELISAでAChRおよびMuSK抗体を盲検検査し、最終診断を基準に感度・特異度・ROC曲線を評価。  
結果：152例がMGと診断。AChR抗体検出感度はL-CBAが71.7%、F-CBAが69%、ELISAが63.8%、特異度はL-CBA・F-CBAが97.7%、ELISAは69.1%であった。ELISAは偽陽性が多く、CBAsとの一致度も低かった。MuSK抗体は感度が低いが特異度は100%であった。ROC解析でL-CBA（AUC0.85）がF-CBA（0.83）よりやや優位。  
結論：L-CBAおよびF-CBAはELISAよりAChR抗体検出に優れ、特にL-CBAは診断精度が高い。固定法も実用的で日常検査に適する。一方、ELISAは特異度が低く慎重な解釈が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、重症筋無力症（MG）診断におけるアセチルコリン受容体（AChR）および筋特異的キナーゼ（MuSK）抗体検査の精度を比較した。生細胞ベースアッセイ（L-CBA）と固定CBA（F-CBA）は、間接ELISAよりも感度・特異度が高く、特にL-CBAが最も優れた診断性能を示した。ELISAは偽陽性が多く特異度が低いため注意が必要である。L-CBAとF-CBAはMG診断において信頼性の高い検査法である。

items.title: Rate of Autoimmune Diseases in the 10 Years Preceding Myasthenia Gravis Diagnosis: A Nationwide Cohort Study in South Korea.
items.abstract: Patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) are frequently associated with other autoimmune diseases. However, the temporal relationship between autoimmune diseases and MG remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the rates and temporal patterns of autoimmune diseases during the 10 years preceding MG diagnosis. This retrospective population-based cohort study analyzed claims data from the Korean National Health Insurance Service between 2010 and 2021 and included individuals aged ≥20 years. MG was defined using the International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision (ICD-10) code (G70.0) and Rare Intractable Disease registration (V012). Each MG case was matched with 10 controls by age, sex, and index year. Outcomes were autoimmune thyroid disease (AITD), systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), seropositive rheumatoid arthritis (SRA), Sjögren syndrome (SjS), psoriasis, type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM), Crohn disease, and ulcerative colitis occurring during the 10 years before the index year. Rate ratios (RRs) and 95% CIs were estimated using Poisson regression models for 0-2, 2-5, and 5-10 years before the index year. A total of 8,355 patients with MG and 83,550 matched controls were included. The mean age (SD) was 53.7 (16.0) years, and 44.1% were male. Patients with MG had a higher rate of any autoimmune disease during 10 years before diagnosis than controls (RR 2.12, 95% CI 1.97-2.28), with the highest rates in 0-2 years before diagnosis (RR 4.27, 95% CI 3.78-4.83). SLE (RR 4.87, 95% CI 2.71-8.77), SjS (RR 4.75, 95% CI 3.01-7.50), AITD (RR 3.66, 95% CI 3.29-4.07), and SRA (RR 2.45, 95% CI 1.89-3.19) showed the strongest associations. Psoriasis (RR 1.68, 95% CI 1.25-2.25) and T1DM (RR 2.03, 95% CI 1.52-2.71) were associated with MG only within 0-2 years before diagnosis, whereas Crohn disease and ulcerative colitis were not associated. Autoimmune diseases were more frequent in the years preceding MG diagnosis than in controls, particularly within 2 years before diagnosis. Strong associations were observed for SLE, SjS, AITD, and SRA. However, these findings should be interpreted with caution because of limitations of administrative claims data.
items.summary_ja:
背景：重症筋無力症（MG）患者は他の自己免疫疾患を合併しやすいが、自己免疫疾患とMG発症の時間的関係は不明である。  
方法：韓国国民健康保険サービスの2010～2021年の診療報酬請求データを用い、20歳以上のMG患者8,355例と年齢・性別・基準年で一致させた対照群83,550例を対象に、MG診断前10年間の自己免疫疾患発症率を後ろ向きコホート研究で解析した。自己免疫疾患はAITD、SLE、SRA、SjS、乾癬、1型糖尿病、クローン病、潰瘍性大腸炎とした。  
結果：MG患者は診断前10年間で自己免疫疾患の発症率が対照群の約2.1倍（特に診断直前2年間は約4.3倍）と高かった。特にSLE、SjS、AITD、SRAとの関連が強く、乾癬と1型糖尿病は診断直前2年以内に限り有意な関連を示した。クローン病と潰瘍性大腸炎は関連しなかった。  
結論：MG発症前に自己免疫疾患の頻度が高く、特に診断直前2年で顕著であった。SLE、SjS、AITD、SRAとの強い関連が示されたが、保険請求データの限界を考慮し慎重な解釈が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、重症筋無力症（MG）診断前10年間における自己免疫疾患の発生率と時系列パターンを韓国の全国保険データで検討した。MG患者は対照群に比べ自己免疫疾患の発症率が有意に高く、特に診断直前2年間で顕著であった。全身性エリテマトーデス、シェーグレン症候群、自己免疫性甲状腺疾患、リウマチ性関節炎との関連が強く認められたが、クローン病や潰瘍性大腸炎との関連はなかった。データの限界に留意が必要である。

items.title: Long-Term Cancer and Mortality After Thymectomy.
items.abstract: Long-term health effects of thymectomy in adults remain uncertain. Previous reports suggested associations with increased mortality, cancer incidence, and autoimmune disease, although these findings may reflect differences in patient selection, surgical indication, or follow-up duration. We aimed to examine long-term outcomes following adult thymectomy. We performed a propensity score-matched retrospective study of patients who underwent thymectomy or comparator cardiothoracic procedures, with follow-up extending to 10 years. Primary outcomes were all-cause mortality, new-onset malignancy, and autoimmune disease. Findings were compared with those reported in a recent study that has raised caution regarding thymic excision. We identified 425 patients who underwent thymectomy and 5401 controls who underwent coronary artery bypass or valve surgery. After matching, 398 patients remained in each group. Thymectomy was not associated with increased mortality at 5 years (HR = 0.63; 95% CI, 0.38-1.04) or 10 years (HR = 0.78; 95% CI, 0.54-1.13). Excluding reclassified thymic cancers, 5-year extrathymic malignancy incidence was 2.3% versus 1.8% (p = 0.54); no significant differences were observed in immune-related disease. Mortality was higher among patients with thymic malignancy. Among MG patients, only one event occurred, precluding reliable estimation. Thymectomy was not associated with excess mortality or malignancy at 10 years compared with matched cardiothoracic controls. Indication-stratified analyses within the thymectomy cohort showed higher mortality for thymic malignancy, with insufficient events to assess outcomes in MG patients. These findings do not support a generalized survival penalty from thymectomy, though caution is warranted for incidental thymic removal.
items.summary_ja:
背景：成人における胸腺摘出術（胸腺摘除）の長期的な健康影響は不明瞭であり、過去の報告では死亡率や癌発生率、自己免疫疾患の増加が示唆されていたが、患者選択や手術適応、追跡期間の違いが影響している可能性がある。  
方法：胸腺摘出術を受けた患者425名と冠動脈バイパスや弁手術を受けた対照群5401名を対象に、傾向スコアマッチングを用いた後ろ向き研究を実施し、最大10年間追跡した。主要評価項目は全死亡率、新規発症の悪性腫瘍および自己免疫疾患とした。  
結果：マッチング後は各群398名となり、胸腺摘出術は5年（HR=0.63, 95%CI 0.38-1.04）および10年（HR=0.78, 95%CI 0.54-1.13）で死亡率の増加と関連しなかった。胸腺癌を除く5年の胸腺外悪性腫瘍発生率は2.3%対1.8%（p=0.54）で有意差はなく、免疫関連疾患にも差は認められなかった。胸腺癌患者では死亡率が高かった。重症筋無力症患者ではイベント数が少なく評価困難であった。  
結論：胸腺摘出術は10年間の追跡で全死亡率や悪性腫瘍の増加と関連せず、一般的な生存率低下を示す証拠はない。ただし、偶発的な胸腺摘出には注意が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 成人の胸腺摘出術後の長期的影響を検討した結果、10年間の追跡で死亡率や新規悪性腫瘍、自己免疫疾患の増加は認められなかった。胸腺悪性腫瘍患者では死亡率が高かったが、重症筋無力症患者の評価は事象数不足で困難であった。胸腺摘出は一般的な生存率低下を示さず、偶発的な胸腺摘出には注意が必要と結論付けられた。

items.summary_ja:
背景：成人における胸腺摘出術（胸腺摘除）の長期的な健康影響は不明瞭であり、過去の報告では死亡率や癌発生率、自己免疫疾患の増加が示唆されているが、患者選択や手術適応、追跡期間の違いが影響している可能性がある。

items.summary_short_ja: 成人における胸腺摘出術の長期的影響を、心臓胸部手術患者と比較した後ろ向き研究で検討した。10年追跡の結果、胸腺摘出は全死亡率や新規がん発症、自己免疫疾患の増加と関連せず、胸腺悪性腫瘍患者のみ死亡率が高かった。重症筋無力症患者の評価は事象数不足で不明。胸腺摘出による一般的な生存率低下は示されなかったが、偶発的な胸腺摘出には注意が必要である。

items.title: Comparison of the Efficacy and Safety of Myasthenia Gravis Treatments: A Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract: In the past decade, several novel therapies have shown promise in treating generalized myasthenia gravis (MG); however, no head-to-head prospective studies have compared their efficacy and safety. To assist clinicians in navigating this complex treatment landscape, we sought to compare treatments while accounting for differences in trial populations. We conducted a Bayesian network meta-analysis (PROSPERO ID: CRD42023428733) of MG treatments. We searched Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, CENTRAL, and MEDLINE up to May 2, 2025, for randomized trials in MG. Two independent reviewers (N.M. and M.R.) identified prospective multiarm studies of adults (18 or older) with generalized MG that reported mean treatment difference, with uncertainty, in MG-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) or Quantitative MG (QMG) score change from baseline. Of 4,823 eligible studies, 27 placebo-controlled randomized trials (placebo n = 1,086; treatment n = 1,232) were included that targeted B cells, neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn), complement activity, CD40, and interleukin-6 signaling, as well as immunoglobulin G and broad immunosuppression therapy. Compared to those treated with placebo and standard of care, QMG scores decreased by an average of -3.63 (95% credible interval -4.43 to -2.77) points more in patients treated with FcRn inhibitors, -2.59 (-3.92 to -1.28) points more in patients treated with C5 complement inhibitors (C5i), and -2.50 (-5.11 to 0.12) points more in patients treated with CD19 FcRn inhibitors, C5i, and CD19
items.summary_ja:
背景：全身性重症筋無力症（MG）に対する新規治療法が近年増加しているが、これらの治療の効果と安全性を直接比較した前向き試験は存在しない。  
方法：MG治療の効果を比較するため、ベイズネットワークメタアナリシスを実施した。2025年5月までに報告された成人全身性MG患者を対象とした多群ランダム化比較試験27件（プラセボ対照、計2,318例）を対象に、MG-ADLおよびQMGスコアの変化を評価した。  
結果：プラセボおよび標準治療と比較し、FcRn阻害剤群ではQMGスコアが平均-3.63点（95%信用区間-4.43～-2.77）、C5補体阻害剤群では-2.59点（-3.92～-1.28）低下し、CD19標的FcRn阻害剤群も同様の改善を示した。  
結論：FcRn阻害剤およびC5補体阻害剤は、全身性MGの症状改善において有意な効果を示し、安全性も考慮した上で治療選択の有力な候補となる。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、全身性重症筋無力症（MG）治療薬の効果と安全性を比較するため、ベイズネットワークメタ解析を実施した。27件の無作為化プラセボ対照試験を対象に、B細胞、FcRn受容体、補体活性、CD40、IL-6シグナルなどを標的とした治療効果を評価。FcRn阻害薬やC5補体阻害薬はプラセボよりQMGスコアを有意に改善し、MG治療の選択肢として有望であることが示された。

items.title: Phenotype, Severity, and Therapy of Patients With LRP4 Antibody-Associated Myasthenia Gravis in the German Myasthenia Gravis Registry.
items.abstract: Lipoprotein receptor-related protein 4 antibody-positive myasthenia gravis (LRP4-Ab-positive MG) is a rare serologic subgroup with poorly defined clinical phenotype. This study investigated demographics, clinical features, treatments, and disease burden of LRP4-Ab-positive MG against other antibody-defined subgroups. Patients from the prospective longitudinal German MG registry tested for LRP4, AChR, and MuSK Abs were grouped and analyzed for symptoms, treatment, and disease burden scores (for example, Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] and Myasthenia Gravis Quality-of-Life 15-item revised version scale [MG-Qol15r]). Among 3,319 patients, 1,432 (43.1%, median age 54, 57.4% female) had complete antibody testing: 4.8% of these were LRP4-Ab-positive (2.4% single-positive; 2.4% LRP4/AChR-Ab-double-positive), 63.6% AChR-Ab-positive, 2.4% MuSK-Ab-positive, 0.8% MuSK/AChR-Ab-double-positive, and 28.4% triple seronegative. LRP4-Ab-single-positive patients reported high symptom rates, and all LRP4-Ab-positive patients showed high rates of escalation (e.g., rituximab) and rescue therapies (e.g., IVIG). Linear mixed-effects models revealed greater disease burden in LRP4-Ab-single-positive patients vs all other subgroups (e.g., vs AChrR-Ab-positive: MG-ADL -2.5 points [95% CI -3.9 to -1.2]; MG-Qol15r -8.4 [95% CI -13.3 to -3.4]). Conversely, LRP4/AChR-Ab-double-positive patients showed burden and treatment patterns comparable with other subgroups. LRP4-Ab-single-positive MG represents a distinct phenotype characterized by high disease burden and treatment needs. By contrast, LRP4/AChR-Ab-double-positive MG phenotypes align more closely with other MG subgroups. German clinical trial registry (drks.de), DRKS00024099, first patient enrolled: February 4, 2019.
items.summary_ja:
背景：LRP4抗体陽性重症筋無力症（LRP4-Ab陽性MG）は稀な血清学的サブグループであり、その臨床表現型は十分に解明されていない。  
方法：ドイツの前向き縦断的MG登録データベースから3,319例中1,432例（43.1％）の抗体検査が完了した患者を対象に、LRP4、AChR、MuSK抗体の有無で分類し、症状、治療内容、疾患負荷（MG-ADL、MG-Qol15rスコア）を比較解析した。  
結果：LRP4抗体単独陽性は4.8％（うち単独陽性2.4％、LRP4/AChR抗体二重陽性2.4％）で、単独陽性群は高頻度の症状とリツキシマブやIVIGなどの治療エスカレーションが認められた。線形混合モデル解析により、単独陽性群は他の抗体群に比べて疾患負荷が有意に高かった（例：AChR抗体陽性群とのMG-ADL差-2.5点、MG-Qol15r差-8.4点）。一方、LRP4/AChR抗体二重陽性群は他群と類似した臨床像を示した。  
結論：LRP4抗体単独陽性MGは高い疾患負荷と治療ニーズを特徴とする独自の表現型であるが、LRP4/AChR抗体二重陽性は他のMGサブグループに近い臨床像を示す。
items.summary_short_ja: LRP4抗体陽性重症筋無力症（MG）は稀なサブタイプで、ドイツMG登録データから臨床特徴や治療効果を他抗体群と比較した。LRP4単独陽性患者は症状が重く、リツキシマブや免疫グロブリン療法などの強力な治療を多用し、疾患負荷も他群より有意に高かった。一方、LRP4/AChR抗体二重陽性は他群と類似した臨床像を示した。LRP4単独陽性MGは独特の重症型であることが示された。

items.title: Comparative Study of Sporadic and Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Related Forms of Myasthenia Gravis-Myositis Overlap Syndrome.
items.abstract: Myasthenia gravis-inflammatory myopathy (MG-IM) overlap syndrome can occur as an immune-related adverse event (irAE) after immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy. Before the advent of ICIs, a sporadic form of MG-IM (s-MG-IM), often thymoma-associated, was already described. This study compared clinical and serologic features, treatment strategies, and outcomes of s-MG-IM and ICI-related MG-IM (ir-MG-IM). We conducted a multicenter, retrospective cohort study across 8 Italian centers, including consecutive patients fulfilling established criteria for both MG and IM, with or without previous exposure to ICIs. Clinical features, antibody profiles, oncologic history, treatments, and outcomes were collected and compared. Available serum samples were tested for binding capacity and pathogenic properties (antigenic modulation and complement-activating capacity) against clustered adult (A) and fetal (F) AChR isoforms using a live cell-based assay (L-CBA). Thirty-eight patients were identified (19 with s-MG-IM and 19 with ir-MG-IM). The ir-MG-IM cohort was older (median 77 vs 59 years,  Although they share some similarities, s-MG-IM represents a chronic, predominantly thymoma-associated overlap syndrome with classical MG and IM features, whereas ir-MG-IM is typically an aggressive, likely monophasic condition characterized by severe myositis, with frequent ocular and cardiac involvement, and lacking classical MG features. Study limitations include the retrospective design, small sample size, and limited serum availability, warranting confirmation in larger prospective cohorts.
items.summary_ja:
背景：筋無力症（MG）と炎症性筋症（IM）が重複するMG-IM症候群は、免疫チェックポイント阻害剤（ICI）治療後の免疫関連有害事象（irAE）としても発症する。一方、ICI登場前から胸腺腫に関連する散発型（s-MG-IM）が知られていた。  
方法：イタリアの8施設で、MGとIMの診断基準を満たす患者38例（s-MG-IM 19例、ir-MG-IM 19例）を対象に後ろ向き多施設コホート研究を実施。臨床所見、抗体プロファイル、腫瘍歴、治療内容、転帰を比較し、血清サンプルを用いてAChR抗体の結合能や病原性を細胞ベースアッセイで評価した。  
結果：ir-MG-IM群は高齢（中央値77歳 vs 59歳）で、重度の筋炎、眼症状や心臓合併症が多く、古典的なMG症状は乏しかった。s-MG-IMは慢性経過で胸腺腫関連が多く、古典的MGとIMの特徴を示した。  
結論：s-MG-IMは胸腺腫に伴う慢性型であるのに対し、ir-MG-IMは重篤かつ単相性の筋炎主体の疾患であり、臨床像や病態が異なる。研究は後ろ向きかつ症例数が限られるため、今後の大規模前向き研究が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、免疫チェックポイント阻害剤（ICI）関連の重症筋無力症-炎症性筋症（ir-MG-IM）と、従来から知られる散発性MG-IM（s-MG-IM）を比較した。s-MG-IMは主に胸腺腫関連の慢性疾患で古典的なMGとIMの特徴を持つ一方、ir-MG-IMは高齢者に多く、重度の筋炎や眼・心臓合併症を伴う急性かつ単相性の疾患で、古典的MGの特徴は乏しい。治療法や予後も異なり、さらなる大規模研究が必要である。

items.title: Risk of Myasthenia Gravis Exacerbation During Pregnancy and Postpartum: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
items.abstract: The impact of pregnancy on the clinical course of myasthenia gravis (MG) remains uncertain, with existing evidence mainly derived from small case series. Using nationwide longitudinal register data, we aimed to assess the risk of MG exacerbation during pregnancy and up to 1 year postpartum. In this population-based cohort study, we included women with MG recorded in the Swedish National MG Register who had singleton pregnancies documented in the Medical Birth Register after MG diagnosis (1987-2019). The exposure was pregnancy, and the outcome was MG exacerbation. The primary outcome measure was hospital admissions with MG during pregnancy and the postpartum year, compared with the year preceding pregnancy. Cox proportional hazards models estimated hazard ratios (HRs), adjusting for disease duration and prior thymectomy. The secondary outcome measure was changes in immunosuppressive MG medications during pregnancy and postpartum. We identified 112 women with MG (median age 30 years) with 176 singleton pregnancies. During pregnancy, women were not more likely to be hospitalized for MG than in the prepregnancy year (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.39-1.41), and there was no increased risk of longer hospital admissions (HR 0.83, 95% CI 0.36-1.88). The postpartum period was associated with an increased risk of prolonged MG admissions during the first 3 months (HR 5.02, 95% CI 1.66-15.24), with a similar risk observed throughout the first 12 months postpartum (HR 4.52, 95% CI 1.26-16.14). During pregnancy, immunosuppressive MG medications were reduced or discontinued in 13 pregnancies and increased in 6. Postpartum, medications were initiated or escalated in 10 pregnancies and reduced in none. The risk of prolonged MG admissions was higher in periods outside of pregnancy compared with the prepregnancy year (HR 2.95, 95% CI 0.84-10.43), suggesting that women conceive during periods of relative disease stability. Pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of MG exacerbation. The postpartum period was linked to more severe or prolonged exacerbations in a minority of women, highlighting the importance of close monitoring after delivery. Milder exacerbations not requiring hospitalization or clear medication escalation may have been underestimated, underscoring the need for larger prospective international studies that include detailed clinical data.
items.summary_ja:
背景：重症筋無力症（MG）における妊娠の影響は不明瞭で、これまでの知見は小規模症例報告に限られていた。  
方法：スウェーデンの全国MG登録と出生登録を用い、1987～2019年にMG診断後に単胎妊娠を経験した112人の女性（176妊娠）を対象に、妊娠中および産後1年間のMG悪化リスクを、妊娠前1年と比較して検討した。主な評価はMGによる入院の有無と期間、二次評価は免疫抑制薬の使用変化である。  
結果：妊娠中のMG入院リスクは妊娠前と変わらず（HR 0.74）、長期入院リスクも増加しなかった。一方、産後3か月間は長期入院リスクが有意に増加（HR 5.02）し、産後12か月間も高リスクが続いた。妊娠中は免疫抑制薬が減量・中止されることが多く、産後は増量または開始される傾向があった。  
結論：妊娠自体はMG悪化リスクを高めないが、産後は一部の女性で重度または長期の悪化がみられ、慎重な経過観察が必要である。軽度の悪化は過小評価されている可能性があり、詳細な臨床データを含む大規模国際前向き研究が求められる。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、スウェーデンの全国登録データを用いて、重症筋無力症（MG）患者の妊娠中および産後1年までの病状悪化リスクを評価した。妊娠中のMG悪化による入院リスクは増加せず、むしろ安定期に妊娠している可能性が示唆された。一方、産後3か月以内に長期入院を伴う悪化リスクが有意に上昇し、産後の綿密な管理の重要性が示された。軽度悪化の把握にはさらなる大規模研究が必要である。

items.title: Efficacy of Pyridostigmine in Myasthenia Gravis: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Crossover Trial.
items.abstract: Pyridostigmine, an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor, is a symptomatic drug approved for the treatment of myasthenia gravis (MG), but no randomized controlled trials substantiate its widespread use. We aimed to assess the efficacy and cost utility of pyridostigmine in patients with anti-acetylcholine receptor-positive MG (AChR MG). A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial was conducted at Leiden University Medical Center, a tertiary center for the treatment of MG in the Netherlands. Main eligibility criteria were current use of pyridostigmine and a stable dose of other MG treatments. Participants were assigned to a sequence of 2 treatment periods for 5 days separated by a 2-day washout, in which patients either first received placebo and then pyridostigmine, or vice versa. Pyridostigmine dosing matched each participant's prestudy regimen. The primary outcome was change in the Myasthenia Gravis Impairment Index (MGII) score. Secondary efficacy outcome measures included the Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scale, the Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) score, and the revised 15-item Myasthenia Gravis Quality of Life (MG-QOL15r) questionnaire. For the post hoc cost-utility analysis, a mathematical model was developed to translate the observed study results into long-term annual effect on societal costs and quality-adjusted life years (QALYs). A total of 19 patients (median age 59 years, 58% female) were recruited between March 23, 2023, and February 21, 2024. The estimated mean difference in the MGII score between pyridostigmine and placebo interventions was 5.3 (95% CI 1.9-8.7,  This trial showed that, in patients with AChR MG chronically treated with pyridostigmine, pyridostigmine demonstrated benefit over placebo across all efficacy outcome measures and substantially reduced societal costs. The trial was registered at EudraCT (2021-004110-20, registration date: July 12, 2022) and ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05919407, registration date: June 16, 2023). First patient enrolled: March 23, 2023. This study provides Class I evidence that, in adults with AChR ab-positive ocular or generalized MG on stable standard-of-care therapy and currently using pyridostigmine, pyridostigmine improves MG symptoms compared with placebo.
items.summary_ja:
背景：重症筋無力症（MG）は抗アセチルコリン受容体陽性患者に対し、ピリドスチグミンが広く使用されているが、ランダム化比較試験による有効性の裏付けは不足していた。  
方法：オランダのライデン大学医療センターで、ピリドスチグミンを現在使用中かつ他の治療が安定している19名の患者を対象に、二重盲検プラセボ対照クロスオーバー試験を実施。各患者は5日間のピリドスチグミン投与期間と5日間のプラセボ投与期間を2日間のウォッシュアウトを挟んで順序を変えて受けた。主要評価項目はMyasthenia Gravis Impairment Index（MGII）の変化。副次評価にはMG-ADL、QMGスコア、MG-QOL15rを用いた。  
結果：MGIIスコアの平均差はピリドスチグミン群でプラセボ群より5.3ポイント改善（95%CI 1.9-8.7）であり、全ての評価指標で有意な改善を示した。さらに、長期的な社会的コストも大幅に削減された。  
結論：抗AChR陽性MG患者の標準治療下でのピリドスチグミン使用は、プラセボと比較して症状を有意に改善し、社会的コスト削減にも寄与することがClass Iエビデンスとして示された。
items.summary_short_ja: 本ランダム化二重盲検プラセボ対照クロスオーバー試験は、抗アセチルコリン受容体陽性重症筋無力症（AChR MG）患者19名を対象にピリドスチグミンの有効性を検証した。結果、ピリドスチグミンはプラセボに比べて症状改善（MGIIスコア差5.3）を示し、日常生活機能や生活の質も向上させた。また、社会的コストを大幅に削減することが示された。安定した標準治療下でのピリドスチグミンの使用は、AChR MG患者の症状改善に有効であることがClass Iエビデンスとして示された。

items.title: Efficacy and Safety of Amifampridine in Myasthenia Gravis: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Crossover Trial.
items.abstract: Amifampridine, a short-acting potassium-channel blocker, is the first-line treatment for Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome. Its benefit as add-on to pyridostigmine in acetylcholine receptor (AChR)-positive myasthenia gravis (MG) has been proposed, but no randomized controlled trials have been conducted. We aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of amifampridine in AChR-MG with insufficient symptom control on pyridostigmine. A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial was conducted at Leiden University Medical Center, a tertiary center for the treatment of MG in the Netherlands, as part 2 of the IMPACT-MG trial. Eligible patients had either completed part 1 (pyridostigmine vs placebo) or failed the initial 2-day pyridostigmine washout, and had an Myasthenia Gravis Impairment Index (MGII) score >10. Participants were randomized (1:1:1) to 1 of 3 treatment sequences. Each treatment period lasted 5 days, with a 2-day washout between treatments, during which participants received either 30 mg or 60 mg of amifampridine modified release, or placebo. The primary outcome was the difference in MGII score between the 2 amifampridine dosages and placebo. Pharmacokinetics, safety, and tolerability were assessed throughout the trial. Between March 2023 and April 2024, 20 patients were enrolled (median age 60 years, 55% female). For the MGII score, the estimated mean differences were -1.0 (95% CI -4.1 to 2.0,  The addition of amifampridine to pyridostigmine was not superior to treatment with pyridostigmine alone and was associated with a higher incidence of adverse events. The trial was registered at EudraCT (2021-004110-20, registration date: July 12, 2022) and ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05919407, registration date: June 16, 2023). First patient enrolled: March 23, 2023. This study provides Class I evidence that in patients with AChRAb+ MG, the addition of amifampridine to pyridostigmine was not superior to treatment with pyridostigmine alone and was associated with a higher incidence of adverse events.
items.summary_ja:
背景：アミファンプリジンはランバート・イートン筋無力症候群の第一選択薬であり、アセチルコリン受容体陽性重症筋無力症（AChR-MG）においてピリドスチグミンへの追加効果が提案されているが、無作為化比較試験は未実施であった。  
方法：オランダのライデン大学医療センターで、AChR-MG患者20名（MGIIスコア＞10）を対象に、アミファンプリジン30mg・60mgおよびプラセボを用いた二重盲検プラセボ対照クロスオーバー試験を実施。各治療期間は5日間、治療間に2日間のウォッシュアウトを設けた。主要評価項目はMGIIスコアの変化であり、安全性と薬物動態も評価した。  
結果：アミファンプリジン追加群のMGIIスコア改善はプラセボ群と有意差がなく（平均差−1.0、95%CI −4.1～2.0）、副作用の発現率は高かった。  
結論：AChR抗体陽性MG患者において、ピリドスチグミン単独治療に対しアミファンプリジンの追加は有効性を示さず、副作用リスクが増加するため推奨されない。
items.summary_short_ja: アセチルコリン受容体陽性重症筋無力症（AChR-MG）患者において、ピリドスチグミン単独治療にアミファンプリジンを追加する効果と安全性を検証した無作為二重盲検プラセボ対照クロスオーバー試験を実施。20例を対象に評価した結果、アミファンプリジン追加は症状改善に優れず、副作用の発現率が高かった。従って、AChR-MG治療においてアミファンプリジンの追加は推奨されない。
